settings.proxySubtitle: Search and fetching follow global site rules, with direct-first fallback by default. Tools may select a policy per call.

deployment.title: Local services
deployment.scope: Manage the bundled Crawl4AI and SearXNG stack on the Anelf host. It starts in the background by default; containers run independently. Remote services are not updated here.
deployment.missing: Not ready: install and start Docker with Compose v2 on the Anelf host. AI can inspect requirements and setup guidance using retrieval_services.
deployment.connectHint: Start only fills empty endpoints. Connect replaces both service URLs and the crawler token with this host’s settings. Stop does not disable startup on the next launch.
deployment.backgroundHint: Deployment runs in the background and logs update as output arrives. Silence does not imply failure. You can leave this page and return later.
deployment.updateHint: Enter official image tags or sha256 digests for services to update. Blank keeps the current version. Images are pulled first; failed health checks trigger recovery. Settings and data volumes are retained.
